subject: general
question: What sum of money (in ₹) will amount to ₹840 at 4% per annum simple interest in 3 years?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Net **Simple Interest** percentage = Rate × Time = 4% × 3 = 12%

Total **Amount** percentage = 100% (Principal) + 12% (Interest) = 112%

Given, 112% → ₹840

Principal (100%) = (840 ÷ 112) × 100

Principal = 7.5 × 100 = ₹750

**∴ The correct answer is ₹750.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Amount (A) = ₹840

Rate (R) = 4% per annum

Time (T) = 3 years

**Formula Used:**

Amount (A) = Principal (P) + Simple Interest (SI)

SI = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d40281baef2856e5b779137acc328b90b6d6d7b6fc08598e05eaf7e4e5cf2de4.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ A = P + (P × R × T) ÷ 100

⇒ 840 = P + (P × 4 × 3) ÷ 100

⇒ 840 = P + 12P ÷ 100

⇒ 840 = (100P + 12P) ÷ 100

⇒ 840 = 112P ÷ 100

⇒ P = (840 × 100) ÷ 112

⇒ P = 7.5 × 100

⇒ P = ₹750

**∴ The correct answer is ₹750.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Principal Formula

When amount, rate, and time are given, Principal P = (100 × A) ÷ (100 + RT).

Simple Interest Property

In **Simple Interest**, the interest remains constant every year because it is always calculated on the original **Principal**.

Relationship between SI and Amount

Interest = Amount − Principal. In this case, SI = 840 − 750 = ₹90.
